summary: Alpha Compute Corp, a British Virgin Islands foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K on 2026-09-14 carrying an investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) used in meetings with existing and prospective investors. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed, and the crypto-asset-class registrant simply ensures equal access to investor materials referenced into its Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. The 6-K is a routine disclosure of investor-relations content rather than a special situation; no deal terms or regulatory clocks apply, so there is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
